description.value: Overflo is a Korean dessert café on Marine Drive in White Rock, serving coffee, soft-serve ice cream, desserts, and noodles in a self-described peaceful, atmospheric setting. The café opened in 2024 and leans into Korean café culture with a menu built around high-quality coffee beans and carefully crafted sweets. Its Marine Drive location puts it within easy reach of the White Rock waterfront cycling routes.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 36m. Total: 8 spaces.
